last_patch.summary: RONL Business API v2026.10.2 in production: a checklist for every new dependency and a quarterly review of all of them, registry signatures and provenance verified in the audit gate, release SBOMs that list every production package with checks that can fail, and the decision document of the path a case took; it found that the decision document’s fallback does not split a list of document references. Weekly pass at TTL 2cf6a90, LDE a87f64b and RBA c51ec0a: the contributing pages re-checked and re-stamped for the required lockfile review, signature verification, the dependency criteria and the first quarterly reviews, and SBOM checks that can fail; ICTU scores 42, 41 and 40, up from 35, 34 and 33.

previous.summary: CPRMV v0.4.2 in production: rule methods as modules in the vocabulary and the API, Echelons and acknowledged services and organisations, and SHACL shapes without recursion. It found that the released image left the method modules out, which broke /rules and /ref until the hosts were redeployed with the fix in standards/cprmv!20, and that /mcp is unreachable. CPSV Editor v2026.10.1 in production: a lockfile review on every dependency pull request, registry signatures and provenance verified in the audit gate, a quarterly dependency review, and release SBOM checks that can fail. Linked Data Explorer v2026.10.2 in production: phases set in the Modeler with RBA's own rule, a process id unique per organisation, RoPA records nested under their shell, and signature verification in CI.
